title: Registrar un ciudadano con datos válidos
description: Este test verifica que una persona puede registrarse correctamente como ciudadano y recibir una cuenta activa.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the registration form with valid citizen details
Submit the registration form
Verify the citizen account is created
Verify the account is shown as active

title: Iniciar sesión y ver el perfil autenticado
description: Este test verifica que un usuario registrado puede iniciar sesión y acceder a su perfil autenticado.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the authenticated profile view
Verify the authenticated user profile is displayed
Verify the user is recognized as logged in

title: Verificar que el sistema responde y muestra el estado de base de datos
description: Este test verifica que la verificación de salud del sistema devuelve un estado operativo de la API y de la base de datos.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/health
Verify the API health status is displayed
Verify the database health status is displayed

title: Register a RAEE device
description: A citizen can create a RAEE record and receive a tracking code for the new device.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the RAEE registration page
Fill in the category field with a valid category
Fill in the brand field with a valid brand
Fill in the model field with a valid model
Submit the RAEE registration form
Verify the new RAEE record is created
Verify a tracking code is displayed for the new record

title: Publicly track a RAEE by code
description: A public user can look up a RAEE with a valid tracking code and see its public ficha and history without personal data.

steps.description: Navigate to the public tracking page
Fill in a valid tracking code
Submit the tracking search
Verify the public RAEE ficha is displayed
Verify the tracking history is displayed without personal data

title: Create a delivery request for a RAEE device
description: A citizen can request either delivery or pickup for one of their registered RAEE devices and the request is created successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the delivery request creation page
Select one of the citizen's registered RAEE devices
Select an active collection center
Select a valid request type
Select a valid scheduled date and time
Submit the delivery request form
Verify the delivery request is created
Verify the request appears in the user's request history or confirmation view

title: Rechazar el inicio de sesión con credenciales inválidas
description: Este test verifica que el sistema no permite iniciar sesión con correo o contraseña incorrectos.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with invalid values
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible

title: Record a technical evaluation for a received RAEE
description: An assigned center worker can register a technical evaluation for a received RAEE and assign its environmental destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the technical evaluation page
Select a received RAEE
Select a destination type
Select a physical condition
Select whether the device is operational
Fill in a valid weight value
Submit the evaluation form
Verify the evaluation is created
Verify the RAEE is marked as evaluated

title: Receive a pending delivery request at the center
description: An assigned center worker can mark a pending request as received and the request changes to completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the center request queue
Open a pending request
Mark the request as received
Verify the request is marked as completed
Verify the device is marked as received

title: Consultar resumen global de reportes como administrador
description: Verifies that an administrator can access the global reports summary and see the management totals and weight indicators.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the reports summary
Verify the global reports summary is displayed
Verify totals and weight indicators are displayed

title: Rechazar el registro con correo duplicado
description: Este test verifica que el sistema impide crear una cuenta ciudadana con un correo ya registrado.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the registration form with a new citizen and an email already used earlier in the test
Submit the registration form
Verify a duplicate registration error is visible

title: Bloquear el acceso administrativo a un usuario no administrador
description: Este test verifica que un usuario sin permisos de administración no puede acceder a las funciones de administración de usuarios.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} for a non-admin user
Submit the login form
Open the user administration view
Verify a forbidden access message is visible

title: Create a collection center as an administrator
description: An administrator can create a new collection center with valid data and see the center created.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /centros
Open the new center form
Fill in the center name with a unique value
Fill in the address field with a valid address
Fill in the district code field with a valid ubigeo
Submit the center form
Verify the new collection center is displayed

title: Deactivate a collection center as an administrator
description: An administrator can deactivate an existing collection center and see it marked inactive.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /centros
Open an existing collection center
Change the center status to inactive
Save the center status
Verify the center is shown as inactive

title: List only my RAEE devices
description: A citizen can open their RAEE list and see only their own registered devices with their current status information.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the citizen RAEE list page
Verify the citizen's RAEE records are displayed
Verify each displayed record belongs to the logged-in citizen

title: Verificar que un administrador puede listar usuarios
description: Este test verifica que un administrador autenticado puede acceder al listado completo de usuarios del sistema.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} for an administrator
Submit the login form
Open the user administration view
Verify the user list is displayed
Verify multiple users are visible in the list

title: View and filter center requests by status
description: An assigned center worker can open the request queue and filter requests by status, including an empty result for an unsupported status filter value.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the center request queue
Select a valid request status filter
Verify matching requests are displayed
Select an invalid request status filter value
Verify an empty result is displayed

title: Crear un usuario encargado asignado a un centro
description: Este test verifica que un administrador puede crear un encargado y asignarlo correctamente a un centro de acopio.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} for an administrator
Submit the login form
Open the create user flow for an assigned manager
Fill in the new manager form with valid data and a selected center
Submit the new manager form
Verify the new manager account is created
Verify the manager is assigned to a center

title: Admin manages active users and collection centers
description: An administrator can view users and centers, create or activate entries, and toggle their active status from the admin area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the administration users page
Create or open a user record
Toggle the user's active status
Navigate to the administration centers page
Create or open a center record
Toggle the center's active status
Verify the updated user and center records are displayed in their new state

title: Restringir el resumen de reportes a usuarios sin permiso
description: Verifies that a non-admin user cannot access the global reports summary and is shown a forbidden response or access denied state.

Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the reports summary
Verify access to the reports summary is denied
Verify a forbidden message is displayed

Navigate to the delivery request creation page
Select one of the citizen's registered RAEE devices

Select a valid scheduled date and time

Open the delivery request form again for the same device
Submit the delivery request form again
Verify a duplicate-request validation message is shown

title: Desactivar una cuenta de usuario desde administración
description: Este test verifica que un administrador puede desactivar una cuenta existente.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} for an administrator
Submit the login form
Open the user administration view
Select an existing user account

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the reports summary page
Verify the global report summary is displayed
Verify aggregated management metrics are visible

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the reports summary

title: Track a RAEE publicly regardless of code casing
description: A public user gets the same tracking result when entering the same tracking code with different letter casing.

steps.description: Navigate to /publico/rastreo
Fill in a valid tracking code into the tracking code field using mixed casing
Submit the tracking lookup
Verify public device data is displayed
Verify a history timeline is displayed

title: Register a RAEE with invalid data
description: A citizen sees validation feedback when trying to submit a RAEE record with invalid required fields or an invalid category.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the RAEE registration page
Leave the required fields empty
Submit the RAEE registration form
Verify validation errors are shown for the invalid RAEE data

description: A public user can retrieve the active collection center catalog and see only active centers by default.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/catalogos/centros
Verify active collection center data is displayed

title: Block invalid technical evaluation data

Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}

Submit the login form
Navigate to the technical evaluation page
Select a received RAEE
Leave the destination field empty
Fill in an invalid weight value
Submit the evaluation form
Verify validation errors are shown for the invalid evaluation data

title: Rechazar el envío de inicio de sesión en formato incorrecto

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials using the unsupported request format
Submit the login form
Verify a validation error is visible
